doc: M3-AUD-861 (M3-BPR-421/422; ADR 0041; Git LFS, ADR 0173): every Act I ability's own sound (battle_sfx.json `vfx` names them by effect id) and the swing/reel Swell styles' rows (assets_src/sfx/act1_ability_sfx.py).

abl_quick_hit._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Rhen: a quick light cut, foam-white.

abl_undertow_cut._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Rhen: a cut that drags down like the undertow: teal spray pulled under.

abl_mend._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Asha: shallow water lifting off the wound (water, not glimmer).

abl_hasten._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Asha: quick pale streaks rising past the ally.

abl_ward._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Asha: a ring of reef-blue light lifting around the ally.

abl_shell_breaker._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Toma: shell plates cracking off the target.

abl_challenge._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Toma (Ch8): the challenge, a spark at the foe's head.

abl_hold_the_stair._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Toma (Ch8): he sets his shield over the stair.

abl_stand_firm._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Toma (Ch8): feet set, dust settling.

abl_stand_fast._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ch8: a hero braces on the wall-walk.

abl_return_tide._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Toma's Swell: the tide thrown back out from the stair.

abl_ember._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ysolde: a small flame climbing the target.

abl_frost._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ysolde: salt-glass shards of rime falling.

abl_slow_hex._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ysolde: ink-dark motes settling over the target.

abl_written_light._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ysolde's Swell: written strokes of pale light across each foe (not glimmer).

abl_anchor_fall._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Kerrid: the anchor comes down: dust and stone.

abl_fluke_cleave._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Kerrid: the anchor-fluke bites: iron chips and splinters.

abl_snub_line._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Kerrid: the line snubbed hard: rope fibres snapping.

abl_flash_housing._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Liss: the lamp housing's flash in the foe's eyes (oil light; capped by particles, not a screen flash).

abl_reel_shot._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Liss: the line strikes home, brass bright.

abl_hoist_haul._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Liss (Ch8): the hoist hauls a group up.

abl_brine_lash._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ilun: a lash of brine.

abl_tidal_ward._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ilun: water rising in a ring around itself.

abl_floodnet._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ilun's Swell: a steady net of bound threads over each foe (bound light: no drift).

abl_forge_bolt._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Kahre: a forge-hot bolt.

abl_last_strike._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Kahre's Swell: raw lightning down onto the foe.

abl_kite_flare._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Virel: a kite's flare drifting down on the foe.

abl_flare_line._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Virel's Swell: the kite-string burning, a flare on each foe.

abl_ash_rake._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: An ashwing rakes: ash streaks.

abl_wing_dust._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Ash shaken from a wing over each foe.

abl_bank_the_fire._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Cinder Matron banks her fire.

abl_ladle_swing._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Cinder Matron's ladle: molten slag.

abl_slag_pour._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Cinder Matron pours slag over the party.

abl_recrust._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Cinder Matron's crust closes over her.

abl_breach._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Breach: the wall gives under the Reach.

abl_crust_slam._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Reach's crust slams.

abl_undertow_pull._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Reach pulls at the party's footing.

abl_brine_iron._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Inquisitor's brine-iron: a salt burn.

abl_shell_wall._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Inquisitor's red shell armour closes.

abl_torch_hulk._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Inquisitor torches the hulk: smoke over each foe.

abl_hound_bite._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Order's hound bites.

abl_brine_spit._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A crab spits brine.

abl_pinch._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A crab's pinch: shell grit.

abl_tide_claw._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A tide crawler's claw: the Undertow's light, sideways.

abl_housing_glare._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A wreck crab's lamp-housing glare.

abl_dive_rake._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A gull's raking dive: pale feathers.

abl_wing_peck._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A squall wing pecks.

abl_spark_spit._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A vein sparker spits sparks.

abl_lure_glow._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The lantern eel's lure: a cold glow.

abl_oil_slap._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: An oil slug slaps: black oil.

abl_smother._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: An oil slug smothers.

abl_polyp_mend_hit._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A polyp's held motes mend its ally (sinking, never rising).

abl_limpet_clamp._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A limpet clamps down.

abl_pull_in._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A slag tortoise pulls into its shell.

abl_shell_ram._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A slag tortoise rams.

abl_sail_drop._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A sail leech drops over the target.

abl_skim_bite._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: A skipper's bite out of the shallows.

abl_glass_jab._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The bottle hermit's glass.

abl_glass_flare._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The hermit's bottle flares.

abl_gnaw._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Hullgnaw's gnaw: the spawn's wound-light, sinking.

abl_thrash._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: Hullgnaw thrashes in its ribs.

abl_hood_slam._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Drownbell's hood comes down.

abl_flood_surge._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Drownbell's flood surges over each foe.

abl_undertow_surge._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Drownbell's undertow drags at each foe's feet.

abl_haul._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Spar-Wraith hauls its spar down on a foe.

abl_sea_lash._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The Spar-Wraith lashes the party with the sea.

abl_shroud_sweep._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The spar-wraith's shroud sweeps the party.

abl_spar_stab._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-421: The spar-wraith's spar: splinters.

whoosh_swing._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-422: Kerrid's Swell: the anchor swung round on its line

swell_kerrid._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-422: Kerrid's Swell: the anchor landing

reel_whir._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-422: Liss's Swell: the line paid out and snubbed

swell_liss._note: M3-AUD-861 / M3-BPR-422: Liss's Swell: the reel-stop's bright brass strike

abl_swell_weighted_swing._note: M3-AUD-864: Kerrid's Swell finisher (long_hold): the flat iron sweep at knee height and the wet sand thrown out, over swell_kerrid's landing

abl_swell_reel_stop._note: M3-AUD-864: Liss's Swell finisher (three_reel_charge): the brass ring locking shut, then the salt-glass flash held on bound light
